region: Queensland coast and the Great Barrier Reef
sensitiveRule: sensitive = threatened: EPBC Act CR/EN/VU/Conservation Dependent, OR Queensland Nature Conservation Act CR/EN/VU, OR IUCN Red List CR/EN/VU. Sensitive rows are generalised to a 0.1 degree grid in every public output. When unsure, true. A row whose status is still to verify (verifyStatus) is sensitive until checked. Group-only sightings (no species named) are always generalised: every group is sensitive.
statusSources: EPBC: Species Profile and Threats Database (SPRAT), environment.gov.au/cgi-bin/sprat
QLD: WildNet / Nature Conservation (Animals) Regulation 2020 schedules
verifyNote: Rows with verifyStatus: true carry a status recalled, not re-checked on 2026-10-05; check them against SPRAT and the IUCN Red List before the catalogue ships. Verified on 2026-10-05: humpback and snubfin dolphins (EPBC VU 2025), little tern (EPBC VU 2025, QLD EN), great knot and red knot (EPBC VU 2024), bar-tailed godwit baueri (EPBC EN 2024), shy albatross (EPBC EN 2020), scalloped hammerhead (EPBC CD), whale shark (EPBC VU), grey nurse shark east coast (EPBC CR), great hammerhead (not EPBC listed).
imagesPolicy: No photographs or copyrighted artwork in the catalogue: each group draws its own SVG glyph (components/sightings/SightingGlyphs.tsx).
